data: Does the figure show a relationship between rank and sentiment scores?

The figure shows two lines representing the relationship between rank and sentiment scores. The black line represents the average sentiment score across all words, while the red dashed line represents the sentiment score of the most frequent word. Both lines show a negative correlation between rank and sentiment scores, meaning that as the rank increases, the sentiment score decreases. This is evident from the downward trend of both lines as they move from left to right on the x-axis. Therefore, the figure does show a relationship between rank and sentiment scores.
